title: Geneva Rising Revisited
author: Wren Sterling
blurb: Bram Galloway, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
